title.narrative: Dialogue for Change through Art and Culture

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to decrease social exclusion among young men and women (age 15-29) in Turkey. The specific objective of the action is reducing othering and polarization by way of organizing culture and art events in five cities in the east and south-east of the country and providing financial support to smaller CSOs for their core functions in line with the overall and specific objectives. the FSTP will cover the whole country
